segments.en:
We worship Ahura Mazda the bountiful; and we worship the Bountiful
Immortals (saying the Spenta). And we sacrifice to the bountiful
saint, and to the bountiful anticipative understanding. Also we
sacrifice to the good and bountiful Armaiti (the ready mind).
And we worship her together with the bountiful creatures in the
creation of the pure. And we sacrifice to the holy creatures who
have intelligence as their first, (to those foremost in their
mind). And we worship the omniscient understanding, and Him who
is Ahura Mazda (Himself).
segments.zh:
我們崇拜阿胡拉‧馬茲達，大天神；並且我們崇拜大天神
大天神（誦說斯彭塔）。並且我們獻祭給大天神
聖者，並且給予大天神的預見性理解。此外我們
我們獻祭給善良且大天神的斯彭塔‧阿爾邁提（準備好的心思）。
此外我們敬拜她與大天神的生物一起在
此外我們獻祭給聖潔的生物誰
具有智慧作為他們的首要，（對於那些在他們的最前面的
心智）。我們崇拜全知的理解，和祂誰
是阿胡拉‧馬茲達（祂自己）。

segments.en:
And we sacrifice to the shining sun,
which is the highest of the high; yea, we worship the sun together
with the Bountiful Immortals, and the Manthras with their good
ceremonies. Also we sacrifice to the glorious achievements, and
to this glory (which we have gained). And we sacrifice to the
herds which have the Fire and its blessings. Also we worship the
holy benefit which is so widely diffused, and that wisdom which
is the bounteous Armaiti, whose are the laws of the Righteous
Order, and of those holy creatures who have Righteousness as their
first. 1. The word spenta throughout alludes to the Gâtha Spentâmainyu, 
 but it is of course not without grammatical application. 2. In the Bundahishm especially referred to Ahura.
segments.zh:
我們向閃爍的太陽獻祭，
這是最高的高；是的，我們一起崇拜太陽
與大天神同在，以及曼特拉斯及其善行
此外我們向光榮的成就獻祭，以及
向這個榮耀（我們已獲得的）。以及我們向
擁有火及其祝福的群羊。此外我們崇拜
聖利益的如此廣泛散布，以及那智慧的
是豐饒的阿爾邁提，其擁有正義者的律法
秩序，以及那些聖潔生物，其以正義為其
首先。1. 詞彙 spenta 在整個中暗指 Gâtha Spentâmainyu，
但它當然沒有語法應用。2. 在 Bundahishm 中尤為提及 Ahura。

segments.en: Or, "together with the bountiful creatures we worship the holy creatures."
segments.zh: 或者，「我們與豐饒的造物一起崇拜聖潔的造物。」

此表達或許是偶然決定之
 詞彙 manô 在 Ahuna vairya [Ahunwar] 公式中的位置；
 請參見 Y. 19.12。

segments.en:
"Fire-made" is unintelligible; "fire gifts-having" may refer to 
 the flocks and herds, as expressing the source of that prosperity 
 which is represented by the holy Fire.
segments.zh:
「火製」難以理解；「火賜予擁有」可能指的是
 群羊與牲畜，作為表達該繁榮之源
 這由聖火所代表。
帕赫勒. 弗拉瓦夫特 蘇德 .
